study type: Multicenter descriptive observational study with prospective follow-up of infants
exposure: Maternal COVID-19 infection during gestation or delivery
Maternal hospitalization due to COVID-19 pathology
cohort: The study included 242 pregnant women diagnosed with COVID-19 in their third trimester of pregnancy and their 248 newborn infants from 16 Spanish hospitals.
finding: No vertical or horizontal transmission of COVID-19 was detected in the newborns during delivery or throughout the first month of life.
mod_finding: Mothers hospitalized due to COVID-19 pathology had a higher risk of ending their pregnancy via C-section.
